module rtlpp_00794 (
   count, fired,
   clk, rst_n, eop, char_in, enable, char_in_vld, stream_id, new_stream_id,load_state
   );

    input clk, rst_n;
    input eop;
    input load_state;
    input [7:0] char_in;
    input enable;
    input char_in_vld;
    input [5:0] stream_id;
    input new_stream_id;
    output [15:0] count;
    output fired;

   reg [15:0] count;
   reg [15:0] speculative_match;
   reg [10:0] state_mem [0:63];
   reg state_in_vld;
   reg [10:0] state_in;
   reg [10:0] state_out_r;
   reg accept_out_r;
   reg [7:0] char_in_r;
   reg [10:0] state_in_r;
   reg char_in_vld_r;
   reg state_in_vld_r;
   wire fired;
   wire accept_out;
   wire [10:0] state_out;

   assign fired = speculative_match;

   always @(posedge clk)
     if (~rst_n)
       begin
          count <= 0;
          speculative_match <= 0;
       end
     else
       begin
          if (load_state)
              speculative_match <= 0;
          if (accept_out_r)
              speculative_match <= 1;
          if (eop)
            begin
               if (enable)
                 begin
                    count <= count + speculative_match;
                    state_mem[stream_id] <= state_out_r;
                 end
               else
                 speculative_match <= 0;
            end
       end

    always @(posedge clk)
      begin
         state_in_vld <= 0;
         if (load_state)
         begin    
            if (new_stream_id)
              begin
                 state_in <= 0;
                 state_in_vld <= 1;
              end    
            else    
              begin
                 state_in <= state_mem[stream_id];
                 state_in_vld <= 1;
              end
         end
      end

    always @(posedge clk)
      if (~rst_n)
         begin
            char_in_vld_r <= 0;
            state_in_vld_r <= 0;
         end
      else
         begin
            char_in_vld_r <= char_in_vld;
            state_in_vld_r <= state_in_vld;
            char_in_r <= char_in;
            state_in_r <= state_in;
            accept_out_r <= accept_out;
            state_out_r <= state_out;
         end

    assign accept_out = (char_in_r == 8'h20);  // Example logic for accept_out
    assign state_out = state_in_r + 1;         // Example logic for state_out

endmodule
